articles.description: Having a talented rookie infielder making the minimum salary would help free up the cash to bowl over a Japanese slugger. It may be the Phillies’ two-part offseason plan to add more offense.
articles.title: The Phillies are counting on Aidan Miller in 2027. Could they also turn to Teruaki Sato for outfield help?

articles.description: Seven-year-old Finn Reilley was one of several kids in Delaware County to dress as McGonigle in a Tigers uniform for Halloween. The support has "meant the world to me," McGonigle said.
articles.title: Kevin McGonigle was Delco’s No. 1 Halloween costume. Now he’s the AL Rookie of the Year.

articles.description: The general managers' meetings will begin Monday evening in Las Vegas, and the Phillies will be there. Former Mets and Orioles GM Jim Duquette joins Scott this week to discuss all this and more.
articles.title: Jim Duquette on the Phillies’ offseason and what to expect at the GM meetings

articles.description: Executives are expected to be busy over the next two weeks before the sport goes dark. Dave Dombrowski is leaving the GM meetings with “more information” as he looks to address his list of needs.
articles.title: Baseball gears up for a player movement frenzy as a lockout looms. Here’s where the Phillies stand.
